blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Vice President Sara Duterte remained a member of the board of directors of Metro City Chow Foods Corp. from 2022 to 2025 despite having no active participation in its operations, the company’s corporate counsel said on Wednesday. Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay made the testimony during the defense’s direct examination on Duterte’s involvement with Metro City Chow, as it is listed in the vice president’s statement of assets, liabilities and net worth from 2017 to 2025. Based on Metro City Chow’s articles of incorporation, Duterte is among the incorporators of the company with a 20 percent share. This is equivalent […]...
